verdict: Ads paused two days this week; leads dropped sharply but are being restored.
narrative: Meta advertising went dark on September 12–13, with zero spend on both days, which stopped all incoming leads for that stretch. That two-day stoppage is the direct cause of the 67% drop in leads over the past 7 days and the spike in cost per lead — the underlying campaign performance had not deteriorated before the pause. Ads are being restored now, and the top campaign ("BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness") will resume full delivery. You should expect lead volume to recover to prior levels once continuous delivery is confirmed. Separately, your Google Business Profile activity also fell this week, mirroring the same disruption period.
